This topic is part of the IB HL IBDP Environmental Science specification.

Environmental Law appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

The IB HL board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Environmental Law.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
